title: Life Admin & Paperwork Quarter-over-Quarter Volume Shift
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=passport:status
| bin _time span=1q
| stats count as events by _time
| streamstats current=f last(events) as prev_q by _time
| eval qoq_pct=round(100*(events-prev_q)/prev_q,1)
| where isnotnull(prev_q) AND prev_q>0
| sort - _time
description: Compares event volume quarter over quarter for life admin telemetry in index=personal.
value: Seasonal life domains swing a lot; a quarter view separates real habit change from normal summer/winter noise without overreacting to one bad week.
implementation: Keep `passport:status` events flowing into `index=personal` with stable timestamps, then review QoQ percent change during quarterly personal ops reviews.
visualization: Column chart of events by quarter with QoQ percent labels.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps how much your life admin activity changed compared with last quarter so you can tell a real shift from normal seasonal ups and downs.
